name: Safe wrapper negotiation requires an external wrapper fixture

input.fixture_ref: Attach a Rust or C++ safe wrapper to an incompatible negotiated C table and inspect its reported ABI version and closed failure.

applicability.reason: The corpus has C ABI negotiation fixtures but no Rust or C++ wrapper fixture.

expect.status: The wrapper reports its C ABI version and fails closed whenever table capabilities cannot meet its safety assumptions.
